title: Store Team Member
schedule: Early, mid or late shifts, posted two weeks ahead
summary: Run the register and coffee bar, restock shelves and coolers, and keep the store clean and safe.
duties: Serve customers at the register and coffee bar|Restock shelves, coolers and the fuel island|Keep the store clean, inside and out
requirements: No experience needed, paid training provided|Able to stand for a full shift and lift up to 40 lb|Available at least two weekend shifts a month

title: Food Service Team Member
schedule: Early shifts, typically 5am to 1:30pm
summary: Cook made-to-order breakfast and lunch from a short menu, with food safety and speed coming first.
duties: Prepare menu items to recipe and on time|Follow food safety and cleaning routines|Keep the kitchen stocked during the rush
requirements: Kitchen experience helps but is not required|Food handler card within 30 days, we help you get it|Comfortable with early starts

title: Shift Lead
schedule: Opening or closing shifts, five days a week
summary: Run the store during your shift: lead the team, handle cash, solve customer problems and open or close the store.
duties: Lead a team of three to six on each shift|Count cash and complete opening or closing routines|Coach new team members during their first weeks
requirements: Six months of retail, food or team lead experience|At least 18 years old|Weekend availability

title: Warehouse Selector
schedule: Fixed night shift, 10pm to 6:30am, Sunday to Thursday
summary: Pick and load store orders in our distribution center using a headset and pallet jack.
duties: Pick orders accurately to the voice system|Build stable pallets for each store|Follow warehouse safety rules
requirements: Able to lift up to 50 lb repeatedly|Pallet jack experience helps, we train|Steady attendance on a fixed shift

title: CDL-A Delivery Driver
schedule: Day routes, home every night, four or five days a week
summary: Deliver to Northline stores on regional routes, unload and check in each delivery.
duties: Drive regional routes to 8 to 12 stores a day|Unload and check in deliveries|Complete pre-trip and post-trip inspections
requirements: Valid Class A CDL|Clean driving record for the last three years|At least 21 years old

title: Facilities Technician
schedule: Monday to Friday days, shared on-call rotation
summary: Fix and maintain coolers, kitchen equipment and fuel systems across a region of stores.
duties: Diagnose and repair refrigeration and kitchen equipment|Carry out planned maintenance on fuel equipment|Plan your own daily route between stores
requirements: Two years of HVAC-R or equipment repair experience|EPA 608 certification, or willing to get it|Valid driver's license

title: Category Analyst
schedule: Hybrid, three days a week in the support center
summary: Analyze sales by category and help decide what goes on the shelves of every Northline store.
duties: Report weekly category performance|Work with buyers on promotions and new items|Visit stores to see the shelves you plan
requirements: Degree or equivalent experience in analytics or retail|Strong spreadsheet skills|Curiosity about why customers buy what they buy
